channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Mais de 100 organizações acusam big techs de interferir nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: Over 100 organizations and experts from 25 countries released an open letter accusing major technology companies of violating Brazilian electoral rules, urging authorities to investigate alleged interference in the 2026 elections. The document highlights concerns about the role of big tech in electoral integrity and digital content regulation. The initiative brings together civil and academic sectors internationally, reflecting growing tensions between governments, digital platforms, and representative democracies.

item.title: Maioridade penal: qual a diferença das emendas defendidas por Lula e Flávio
item.description: Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advocate for lowering the age of criminal responsibility, but propose different age thresholds and categorize distinct crimes. While Lula emphasizes rehabilitation and serious offenses, Flávio prioritizes punishment for specific infractions.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa de ato em Juiz de Fora (MG)
item.description: President Lula participates in a campaign event in Juiz de Fora, MG, as part of the mobilization for the 2026 presidential runoff election, where he will face Flávio Bolsonaro. The visit takes place in the contested Zona da Mata region of Minas Gerais.

item.title: Sem definição sobre maioridade, governo avalia votar PEC na próxima semana
item.description: The federal government is considering voting on the Public Security Amendment Bill (PEC) next week, before the election runoff. The matter was removed from the agenda due to disagreements over reducing the age of criminal responsibility. Senator Camilo Santana proposed an amendment limiting the reduction to 16 years only for heinous crimes, while the opposition suggests 14 years. President Lula expressed support for lowering the age of majority for heinous crimes.

item.title: Canal “Cristãos com Lula” não bate meta e campanha cobra seguidores
item.description: A new Datafolha poll projects a tight runoff race between Flávio Bolsonaro (47%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (45%), with a technical tie when only valid votes are counted. Meanwhile, the WhatsApp channel 'Cristãos com Lula 13', launched with participation from Geraldo Alckmin and Jorge Messias, failed to meet the campaign's expected engagement targets. The electoral scenario remains volatile, with small margins of error that could shift the lead.

item.title: Áudio: Iniciativa do Senado, dia de luto pelo feminicídio convida à conscientização
item.description: Law 15.334, enacted in January 2026, established October 17 as the National Day of Mourning and Memory for Women Victims of Femicide, marking the first official date in Brazil dedicated to this cause. The initiative was led by Senator Leila Barros (PDT-DF), who is currently on leave.

item.title: Fim da 6×1 aprovado: os riscos de uma transição em só 60 dias
item.description: The Senate approved the constitutional amendment ending the 6×1 work schedule and reducing the weekly work hours from 44 to 40, with 75 votes in favor. Vanderlan Cardoso criticized the electoral use of the issue, Mourão voted against, while Erika Hilton and Lula celebrated the approval.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a receber 10 convidados para aniversário da filha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to host 10 guests for a birthday lunch celebrating his daughter Laura's birthday, while serving a home detention sentence. The decision responds to a request from Bolsonaro's defense team, who is under investigation in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Edinho comenta empate de votos do PoderData e diz que Lula “já virou”
item.description: Edinho Silva claimed that Lula has already turned around the presidential race following a new PoderData/Aya poll showing a tie between the former president and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, each with 50% of valid votes. The PT campaign has benefited from the approval of the end of the 6 x 1 workweek and proposals such as free public transportation on weekends.

item.title: Janones dá "missão mais importante" no canal de Lula: "Retomar símbolos"
item.description: André Janones urged supporters of the 'Exército do Lula' to post photos on Saturday (10/17) wearing green and yellow colors and forming the letter 'L' to show support for Lula while challenging the far-right's association with national symbols. The strategy aims to attract undecided voters and weaken the far-right's political identity.

item.title: Perto de voltar a Interlagos, Hamilton diz que se sente em casa no Brasil
item.description: Lewis Hamilton expressed his emotional connection with Brazil, highlighting his status as an honorary citizen since 2022 and his admiration for Brazilian culture and people, particularly tied to the memory of Ayrton Senna. The Ferrari driver shared these sentiments in an official video ahead of the São Paulo Grand Prix, reinforcing his feeling of belonging in the country.

item.title: Flávio e oposição não vão a promulgação do fim da 6 X 1
item.description: Opposition senators, including Flávio Bolsonaro, were absent from the promulgation of the PEC that abolishes the 6 X 1 work schedule, approved by the Senate with 75 votes in favor and 1 against. The measure, which reduces the workday and increases the day off, is a victory for Lula's campaign, who seeks re-election on October 25th. Flávio voted remotely during the solemn session where Lula gave his speech.

item.title: TSE nega pedido de Flávio para restringir apoio de sindicatos e UNE a Lula
item.description: The TSE rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to restrict union and UNE support for Lula, ruling that political support cannot be classified as irregular campaign advertising. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva ordered an investigation into Lula, Alckmin, and union leaders over alleged abuse of power.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a disputa entre Flávio x Lula no segundo turno: veja datas das próximas
item.description: Ten electoral polls will be released between October 17 and 21, ahead of the runoff between Lula and Flávio on October 25. The latest polls show a technical tie between the candidates with minor fluctuations within the margin of error.

item.title: Com sabatina de Lula, Globo tem a maior audiência do dia
item.description: President Lula's interview on TV Globo this Thursday (15) reached 25 points in São Paulo and 28 in Rio de Janeiro, marking the highest ratings of the day in both cities. The interview, conducted by Renata Lo Prete, aired at 9 PM, followed by 'Quem ama cuida,' which scored 24 points in São Paulo. On Friday (16), it will be Flávio Bolsonaro's turn to participate in the same format.

item.title: Alcolumbre negocia idade mínima para indicação ao STF se Flávio Bolsonaro for eleito
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is negotiating the adoption of a minimum age of 55 or 60 for Supreme Court nominations in the event of Flávio Bolsonaro's election, aiming to reduce right-wing influence on the court.

item.title: Emenda do fim da 6x1 é publicada no Diário Oficial. Prazos começam a valer
item.description: The constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule was published in the Official Gazette, starting a two-month deadline for companies to implement two weekly rest days and reduce the workweek from 44 to 42 hours. This measure, one of Lula's campaign pledges, marks the first labor reform since 1988.

item.title: Justiça barra entrega de título de cidadão a Flávio após abaixo-assinado
item.description: The Bahia court suspended the ceremony awarding the Citizen Title to Flávio Bolsonaro in Salvador following a public lawsuit and a petition with nearly 200,000 signatures. The judge deemed the event politically partisan and questioned public spending on relocating the City Hall to Farol da Barra during the runoff campaign.

item.title: A decisão de Alexandre de Moraes sobre a festa de aniversário da filha de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to hold a 16th birthday barbecue for his daughter at his residence in Brasília, allowing nine guests and a professional BBQ chef, conditioned on compliance with security protocols. The restriction on receiving visitors had been imposed by Moraes due to Bolsonaro's conviction for antidemocratic crimes.

item.title: Flávio quer desconfigurar debate sobre segurança, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva criticized the PL and Flávio Bolsonaro for attempting to shift the debate on the Public Security PEC to the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility. The PEC, enacted after abolishing the 6x1 schedule, does not include the reduction, which will be addressed separately under a Senate agreement.

item.title: "Futrica" e "bobagem", define Lula sobre desentendimentos com Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula downplayed his disagreements with Alcolumbre, calling them 'nonsense' and emphasizing the need to govern after elections. The reconciliation led to the enactment of the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule.

item.title: As mudanças de posição de Lula e Flávio após pesquisas na reta final do segundo turno da eleição
item.description: Lula and Flávio adjust their positions in the final stretch of the election, with Lula supporting the reduction of the criminal responsibility age for serious crimes and Flávio backing the end of the 6×1 work schedule, responding to voter pressure and poll results showing a tight race.

item.title: Crusoé: CNT/MDA aponta disputa acirrada entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: CNT/MDA poll shows a tight race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round, with Flávio leading 46.8% to 45.9%. Blank and null votes account for 4.9%, and undecideds stand at 2.4%.

item.title: Crusoé: “Que tipo de seres humanos somos?”, diz Lula sobre escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula (PT) celebrated the approval of ending the 6x1 work scale during a joint session of Congress, emphasizing the need to ensure workers' right to rest. He attended the event with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (Union-AP) and Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicans-PB).

item.title: Dólar se mantém acima de R$ 5, com leve queda após pesquisas e fim da 6x1
item.description: The commercial dollar remained above R$ 5 with slight fluctuations, driven by the Datafolha poll showing a tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in the runoff. The enactment of the PEC ending the 6×1 exchange rate and expectations for the BC's IBC-BR indicator also impacted financial markets.

item.title: PEC do fim da 6×1: Alcolumbre quebra protocolo e faz homenagem a Paulo Paim
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcobebre broke protocol during the ceremony to promulgate the end of the 6×1 workweek to honor Senator Paulo Paim for his long-standing advocacy for reduced working hours. Paim, set to retire at the end of this legislative term, was warmly received by his parliamentary colleagues.

item.title: “Discussão fica para depois do 2º turno”, diz PT sobre reeleição de Motta
item.description: The PT stated that the decision to support Hugo Motta's reelection as Chamber president will be made after the second round of the presidential election, prioritizing Lula's campaign. Parties such as União Brasil, PP, and PSD have already expressed support for the deputy, advocating for an open and plural chamber. The PL focuses on electing Flávio to the presidency and delays negotiations for legislative leadership roles.

item.title: Justiça proíbe Câmara de Salvador de entregar título de cidadão a Flávio em ato de campanha
item.description: The Bahia court blocked the city council of Salvador from awarding the Citizen Title to Flávio Bolsonaro during a campaign event, ordering the postponement until after the 2026 election. The judge warned that the ceremony could compromise impartiality and influence the electoral process, imposing a fine of R$500,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: Charleaux: atitude de Lula sobre maioridade equivale a Flávio com 6x1
item.description: João Paulo Charleaux criticized Lula for supporting lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16, comparing the stance to Flávio Bolsonaro's retreat on the 6x1 scale during a Globo interview.

item.title: Na Globo, Lula erra dado de empregos e exagera sobre partidos no governo
item.description: In a Globo interview, President Lula made errors regarding job creation figures during his terms and exaggerated when describing the party composition in his government. The inaccuracies drew criticism from analysts, raising concerns about campaign messaging accuracy.

item.title: Campanha de Lula relata à OEA e UE suposta assimetria da Meta na eleição
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign reported to international election observation missions that Meta's tools treated content and ads unevenly during the electoral period, raising concerns about potential impacts on election transparency. The information was shared with the Organization of American States (OAS) and the European Union (EU).

item.title: Apoiadores realizam ato pró-Lula nas ruas centrais de Apucarana
item.description: Supporters of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held a pro-campaign rally in Apucarana, using flags and posters to back his re-election bid. The event took place Thursday night.

item.title: Marina Sena promete performance visceral no Estilo Brasil, em Brasília
item.description: Marina Sena will perform at the Estilo Brasil Festival in Brasília on November 19, bringing a theatrical and visceral performance that blends music, theater, and artistic expression. Her artistic trajectory has become increasingly experimental, featuring striking scenes such as the destruction of a rag doll during 'Ouro de Tolo,' interpreted as a critique of patriarchy. The artist seeks to expand the boundaries of performance by connecting body, light, dance, and scenography in her songs' narrative.

item.title: "Gostoso da Esplanada" reage a vídeo viral em ato: “O importante é a pauta”
item.description: The 20-year-old known as 'Gostoso da Esplanada' went viral after appearing shirtless at a pro-Lula rally in Brasília, but emphasized that the focus should be on the political agenda, not his image. He noted that humor and unusual visuals attract young people to political discussions, but this attention must translate into genuine interest in the movement's demands. The video was filmed at a photographer's request and was not part of his plans.

item.title: Eleições 2026: confira as agendas de Flávio e Lula nesta sexta (16/10)
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula carry out campaign commitments for the 2026 election runoff. Flávio secured 47.03% of valid votes, while Lula received 45.16%, advancing to the October 25th ballot. Both teams announce campaign schedules across various Brazilian states.

item.title: Com presença de Lula, Congresso promulga fim da 6x1 nesta sexta-feira
item.description: The National Congress will promulgate on Friday (10/16) the constitutional amendment that ends the 6x1 work schedule in Brazil, allowing reduction from 44 to 42 hours per week in December and 40 hours the following year. The measure, approved in the Senate with 75 votes, is one of Lula's main bets in his reelection campaign.

item.title: Brasileirão: Mirassol e Internacional duelam na luta contra o rebaixamento
item.description: In the 31st round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship, Mirassol and Internacional face each other in a direct relegation battle match, with Mirassol in 15th place (33 points) and Internacional in 17th (32 points). Both teams need points to avoid relegation.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: entenda o que diz o texto e a regra de transição
item.description: Congress approves the pension reform amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, gradually reducing the weekly work hours from 44 to 40. The rule establishes two paid weekly rest days and allows compensatory regimes through collective agreements. President Lula's re-election is aided by the approval of one of his electoral slogans.

item.title: Com rua cheia e medidas, Lula não sai do lugar
item.description: Protests by youth and left-wing influencers did not impact Lula's polling numbers, who maintained his position. The campaign used strategies such as selfie videos and pen exchanges, but without major changes in voting intentions.

item.title: O caso Meta e a disputa no TSE em torno das redes sociais - O Assunto #1826
item.description: The TSE ruled that Meta cannot interfere in political-electoral content distribution after Lula's campaign sued over boosted posts supporting Flávio Bolsonaro. Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze imposed a daily fine of R$ 500,000, while experts debate social media regulation limits during campaigns.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO ou #FAKE na entrevista de Lula à Globo no 2º turno das eleições 2026
item.description: Lula was interviewed by Globo following the first phase of the second round of the 2026 elections, where he commented on recent PF operations involving allies of Flávio Bolsonaro, such as Márcio Canella. The statement was verified as #FACT, as Canella was arrested in the 'Unha e Carne' operation, investigated for crimes like money laundering and cartel formation.

item.title: Entrevista de Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo: veja quando e onde assistir
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, will be interviewed by TV Globo this Friday (16), following the nightly news. The interview, hosted by Renata Lo Prete, will be live at Globo Studios and simulcast on GloboNews and g1.

item.title: Primeira Turma do STF começa a julgar nesta sexta denúncia e pode tornar réu blogueiro aliado de Bolsonaro
item.description: The First Chamber of the STF begins a virtual trial to decide whether blogger Oswaldo Eustáquio, an ally of Bolsonaro, becomes a defendant for criminal association linked to posts and demonstrations against the Lula government and the electoral system. The defense claims the process is being held in absentia and without due process, while Eustáquio has preventive arrest warrants in Brazil.

item.title: Quando será o segundo turno das eleições 2026? Veja a data
item.description: The second round of the 2026 elections is scheduled for Sunday, October 25, with voting from 8am to 5pm BRT. States such as Rondônia, Mato Grosso and Amazonas start at 7am, while Fernando de Noronha begins at 9am. The TSE urges all voters to go to the polls.

item.title: México tenta mostrar que segurança não pode ser um monopólio da direita
item.description: Mexico seeks to show that security should not be a monopoly of the right, while Brazil faces polarized debates after Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. A left-wing seminar with delegates from 39 countries reflected the 2026 Brazilian electoral scenario.

item.title: Congresso promulga aposentadoria especial para agentes de saúde após três meses de espera
item.description: The Brazilian Congress enacted a constitutional amendment establishing special retirement for community health agents (ACS) and disease control agents (ACE), with minimum ages of 57 for women and 60 for men, requiring 25 years of contribution and job performance. The measure is classified by the economic team as part of the 'bomb agenda' and is expected to increase by R$3 billion per year the financial shortfall in pension systems. The enactment follows months of delay and may lead to a Supreme Court lawsuit if no fiscal compensation is provided.

item.title: Congresso promulga fim da escala 6x1 nesta sexta-feira e abre contagem para jornada menor
item.description: The Brazilian Congress enacted a constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 shift and reducing the maximum weekly work hours from 44 to 40, with no salary cuts. The change takes effect in two stages: two months after enactment, the limit drops to 42 hours, and one year later, to 40 hours. President Lula hailed the move as a historic achievement, while the new rules preserve benefits such as overtime and time compensation.

item.title: Jogo está empatado, mas juiz favorece time de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are technically tied in the race for the Planalto, according to Datafolha. Despite Flávio's strategic endorsements, the PT's aggressive campaign and the approval of the 6x1 scale balanced the race. TSE judge Kassio Nunes Marques has been accused of favoring Flávio with controversial decisions.

item.title: Entenda o impasse entre governistas sobre maioridade penal que travou votação da PEC da Segurança no Senado
item.description: Dispute among government senators led Davi Alcolumbre to postpone the PEC da Segurança vote, which Lula intended to use in his campaign. Camilo Santana proposed lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for heinous crimes, against Lula's allies.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: com promulgação, trabalhador começa a ter 2 folgas por semana este ano; veja regra
item.description: With the enactment of the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, Brazilian workers will gain two paid weekly rest days, and the workweek will be reduced from 44 to 40 hours in two stages. Public servants, individual entrepreneurs, and essential service workers are excluded from the rule. The federal government is preparing a decree to regulate the new legislation.
